questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some words are paragraphs.

All paragraphs are essays.

No essay is a story.

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some paragraphs are stories.

(II): All words are essay.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

Some words are paragraphs.

All paragraphs are essays.

No essay is a story.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a78d8f94f5808f00a9671f486388cf4e52c676aefc977b47eecc929222504010.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some paragraphs are stories - **False** (Because "No essay is a story" and "All paragraphs are essays", it implies that no paragraph can be a story. There is no overlap between Paragraphs and Stories.)

II. All words are essays - **False** (Because "Some words are paragraphs" and "All paragraphs are essays", it means some words are essays. However, there can be words that are not paragraphs and thus not essays. The statement "All words are essays" is too strong and not necessarily true based on the given information.)

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
